wording: [Conditions Met: Famed Coach → World-Renowned Coach Class!]
holder-quote: Joseph walked into the wall. Yet it wasn’t done. The voice in his head kept shouting, as if it was as amazed as he was.
Joseph crashed down the stairs. The [World-Renowned Coach], arguably one of the most well-known faces in the world. He jogged past Rags, then jogged backwards.
So I was just going to ask what Erin thought of that. What do you think, Joseph?
